scope: Source QC of the re-converted arXiv 2412.14971v1 author preprint against its PDF. This QC grants no source binding, scientific acceptance, screening decision, registry authority or publication authority.
method: Verified the PDF hash against the acquisition record generated/source-acquisition/codex-websearch-2026/reacquisition-2026-09-22.json before conversion.
Compared the word tokens of the PDF text layer with the Markdown; the missing share is below 0.1 percent and consists of DOI fragments in references.

Rendered PDF pages 16 to 18 and 22 with PyMuPDF, inspected Figures 1 to 3 and Table 5 visually, and compared Tables 1 to 5, headings, page order, Chinese terms and the appendix examples with the Markdown.

structure.headings: Title, abstract, methods, results, discussion, references and Appendix A occur in source order; the running head repeats as a first line.
structure.reading_order: Single-column manuscript text is sequential across all 41 pages.
structure.tables: Tables 1 to 5 are present as Markdown with their cells; Table 5 matches the printed rows on PDF page 22 (printed page 21).
structure.figures: Figures 1 to 3 on PDF pages 16 to 18 (printed pages 15 to 17) are image placeholders; their captions and notes survive.
